# Evidence bundle and production receipt golden vectors, fa-verify format 1.0
# (bead fa-l3c slice 5). Pinned; never regenerated to make a change pass: a
# format change is a new v2 file.
# Producer: crates/fa-notary/tests/golden.rs accumulates the synthetic journal
# of accumulator_v1.txt plus a fifth posting at seq 7 that cites two
# documents (kind 1, bytes "INVOICE golden" and "LEASE golden"), signs its
# checkpoint with the Ed25519 key of seed 0x11 x 32 over a fixed substrate
# chain commitment 0xc0 x 32, and assembles three bundles and one receipt;
# it must reproduce these bytes.
# Verifier: crates/fa-verify/tests/golden.rs verifies them with nothing but
# fa-verify and the public key.
# Lines are `<name> <lowercase hex>`:
#   public_key      the book's checkpoint public key
#   bundle_prefix   every leaf, documents included, cash (0x30) USD balance
#   digest_prefix   BLAKE3("fa:bundle:v1" ‖ bundle_prefix)
#   bundle_account  rent (0x10), every effective day, documents not included
#   bundle_entries  leaves 3 and 4 (0x104, 0x105) named, documents included
#   receipt         bundle_prefix produced by principal 7 at seq 9 under
#                   capability commitment 0xcc x 32, no TimeEvidence
